subject: Post-remediation pen-test revalidation & delta summary for Vertex Cloud integration
messages:
From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@vertexcloud.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: security@vertexcloud.com
Date: Sun, 2 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re-test request after remediation - Vertex integration

Hi Markus,

Thanks for the quick turnaround on the remediation plan. Our security team completed a preliminary review of the remediation PRs and asked whether Redwood could arrange a focussed re-test on the items listed in the original report (attached for reference). Specifically we need: 

- A re-run of the external network and authenticated app tests against the fixed endpoints
- Confirmation that the original critical/ high findings are closed (or have compensating controls documented)
- A delta report that highlights any new findings introduced by the fixes

Can you confirm whether you can run or coordinate a re-test in the week of Aug 9 and produce a short delta attestation we can include in our SOC2 evidence package? If possible, please share an expected artifact list (report + evidence) and point person.

We'd like to keep the scope limited to the issues in ticket SEC-331.

Thanks,
Olivia Barnes
Security Program Manager
Vertex Cloud

Attachment: vertex-initial-pen-test-2026-07.pdf (reported issues)
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: Olivia Barnes <olivia@vertexcloud.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Re-test request after remediation - Vertex integration

Olivia —

Thanks for the note and for narrowing the scope to SEC-331. Hannah and Rishi: can you confirm our availability for a constrained re-test the week of Aug 9? Rishi, please coordinate the authenticated app token access with Vertex (I believe Olivia already has the dev creds). Hannah, can you prepare the remediation evidence export (patch list, config diffs, and the vuln-delta log) and attach an initial summary we can share with their team?

Plan I propose:
1) Internal smoke verification by Wed Aug 5 (Hannah)
2) Coordinated re-test by our internal red-team or 3rd party on Aug 9–10
3) Deliverables to Vertex: re-test report (PDF), vuln-delta CSV, remediation-summary XLSX, and a short verification letter from Redwood for SOC2 evidence

Olivia — is Vertex able to accept a Redwood-generated report for your evidence bundle, or do you need an independent 3rd-party attestation? If you need a 3rd party we will prioritize procurement but it will add time.

Markus
VP, Customer Security
Redwood Inference
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 07:29:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Re-test request after remediation - Vertex integration

Markus / Rishi —

Quick status update after the internal remediation sprint: attached is a short remediation summary and the vulnerability delta log. Highlights: 

- Fixed endpoint auth bypass (PR#4827) — patch deployed to staging and prod config updated; test coverage added.
- Resolved insecure cookie flag on session token (PR#4831) — client and server flags normalized.
- Minor misconfig in CORS for one route; scope-limited fix applied.

Artifacts attached: redwood-remediation-summary-20260805.xlsx, vuln-delta-log-20260804.csv. I can run the internal smoke re-test today and hand off the environment to Vertex for their verification window on Aug 9.

Notes: we used the same test harness as the original engagement to minimize tooling variance. No new high/critical findings surfaced during our internal smoke; there are two low/med items noted in the delta log that are being tracked in SEC-340 and SEC-341.

I'll prepare a draft verification statement once we have the external re-test PDF.

—Hannah
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-remediation-summary-20260805.xlsx; vuln-delta-log-20260804.csv
From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@vertexcloud.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: security@vertexcloud.com
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Re-test request after remediation - Vertex integration

Markus / Team —

Thank you, that schedule worked for us. We've completed our verification window today. Attached is the retest report from our security team (vertex-retest-report-20260809.pdf). Summary: the three original critical/high issues that were in scope have been marked as fixed. The Vertex team ran an authenticated scan against the fixed endpoints and validated the patch on the prod-like instance.

We did identify two medium-severity regression items that appear to be introduced by a config change; both are low-impact and we've included them in the attached retest report (section 4). Please confirm Redwood's acceptance and whether you'll include those items in the remediation tracker (SEC-340/341).

Request: For our SOC2 evidence bundle we need a short delta attestation (one page) that confirms: 
- Which original findings are closed
- Any new findings introduced by the remediation (with links to tracking tickets)
- A statement that the re-test was performed on Aug 9 and which environment was used

If you can provide that attestation and a one-paragraph verification letter by EOD Aug 10 we can finalize our evidence package.

Thanks again,
Olivia
Attachment: vertex-retest-report-20260809.pdf
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@vertexcloud.com>
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2026 22:13:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Re-test request after remediation - Vertex integration

Olivia —

Appreciate the rapid retest and clear report. We accept the two medium items you documented and have created SEC-340 and SEC-341 to track them; Hannah is the owner for fixes and will provide ETA updates in the ticket.

Attached is a short delta attestation and a verification letter for your SOC2 bundle: redwood-retest-verification-letter-20260810.pdf. The attestation states which original findings (IDs 1–3 from your initial report) are closed, lists the two new medium items with links to SEC-340/SEC-341, and confirms the re-test took place on Aug 9 against the staging-prod mirror (v2026.07.31 build).

If Vertex requires an independent 3rd-party attestation, please notify us within 48 hours and we'll start procurement. Otherwise, we consider this item closed from Redwood's side for your SOC2 evidence.

Markus Klein
VP, Customer Security
Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0123
Attachment: redwood-retest-verification-letter-20260810.pdf
